# Open Source AI Radar

> Intelligence platform tracking 10,549 open-source AI repositories
> (45,114,318 combined stars) with a three-axis score: Impact (40%),
> Velocity (35%), Health (25%). Data refreshes daily via automated
> GitHub Actions; last export 2026-11-21.

Unlike plain leaderboards, every project carries an explanation of WHY it
trends: velocity vs its own baseline, breakout detection, anomaly checks,
and category momentum.

## Datasets (static JSON, no auth, CC-BY-4.0)

- [All repos](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/repos.json): 10,549 records — name, description, language, license, stars, forks, timestamps
- [Top ranked](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/top.json): highest radar scores with axis breakdowns
- [Trending](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/trending.json): sorted by velocity (stars/day momentum)
- [Hidden gems](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/gems.json): low-star, high-velocity emerging projects
- [Breakouts](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/breakouts.json): velocity anomalies vs own history
- [Anomalies](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/anomalies.json): statistical outliers incl. star-spike review
- [Categories](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/categories.json): per-category momentum intelligence
- [Stats](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/stats.json): summary counts
- [RSS feed](https://radar.bharatdn.com/api/feed.xml): top 20 trending projects

## Scoring model

Radar Score = Impact x 0.40 + Velocity x 0.35 + Health x 0.25.
Impact: star/fork/watcher percentile ranks. Velocity: stars-per-day,
fork ratio, commit recency, issue activity. Health: freshness, release
cadence, issue load, fork-community shape, bus factor (maintainer count),
and license safety.
